nodes.label: TypeDoc API doc exclusion for default-only Express routers
nodes.rationale: backend/src/routes modules default-export an Express Router with no named exports, so TypeDoc renders them as empty pages; excluding routes from TypeDoc and pointing the Routes handbook to REST API + controller handler docs avoids the empty-page problem. Index generation also skips default-only modules and docs/reference/api is wiped before each TypeDoc run to avoid stale pages.
